Ashwini/1.pt: sua mente é instável nesta leitura. você espalha histórias e se diverte às custas dos outros.
Ashwini/1.en: your mind is unsteady in this reading. you spread tales and enjoy yourself at others’ expense.

Ashwini/2.pt: você se interessa por obras religiosas e avalia os outros. assimila boas qualidades.
Ashwini/2.en: you take an interest in religious works and assess others. you absorb good qualities.

Ashwini/4.en: you are truthful and clever in this reading. it also attributes wealth to you.

Bharani/4.en: you are adamant and headstrong in this reading. you also combine greed and cleverness.

Rohini/3.en: you combine expression, sciences, commerce, adaptability and dexterity. Mercury, Venus and Saturn give reliable results here.

Rohini/4.pt: você tem traços maternais, possessivos e extremistas, com renda de viagens curtas. só Lua ou Júpiter bem posicionados funcionam favoravelmente.
Rohini/4.en: you have maternal, possessive and extreme traits, with income from short journeys. only a well-placed Moon or Jupiter works favorably.
